subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Riverbed (DSelect-k for multi-task ranking)
body:
Dmitri,

Riverbed staffing and resourcing:

Wei owns the gating research questions (expert-count sweeps, entropy regularization interplay); Maren integrates the DSelectKGate layer into ranker A's training stack; Giannis mirrors for ranker B; Bilal builds the FLOPs/latency measurement rig so the serving-cost readout isn't hand-waving.

Compute: ranker retraining fits our existing titan-a100 allocation — biggest job is 32 GPUs for the full-data retrain. No Vulcan or TPU ask this half, which given what I hear about the June reservation crunch is a blessing.

One planning note: I've registered "Project Riverbed" with the PMO tracker under data-platforms so Nadia's office routes launch-review paperwork correctly.

Budget: nothing discretionary; all inside the portfolio envelope.

Daniela
